title: Tonino Picula – On Serbia After the Elections, Who Stands Behind the Students (Podcast Čušpajz #167)

reels.title: Picula to Vučić's Face: You Cannot Speak About Fascism
reels.hook: He told Vučić to his face what no one dared to
reels.why: A complete personal story with a concrete place, year, and dramatic turn. In about 40 seconds, it has conflict, a point, and a consequence.
reels.speaker: Tonino Picula
reels.quote: Someone who has clear fascist episodes in their life cannot speak about fascism.

cards.text: He told Vučić to his face what no one dared to
Tonino Picula, Member of the European Parliament
First and only meeting with Vučić
Official visit of the Committee on Foreign Affairs of the European Parliament
In front of 15 to 20 MEPs, Vučić attacked Croatia.
Someone who has clear fascist episodes in their life cannot speak about fascism.
Tonino Picula – On Serbia After the Elections | Čušpajz #167

reels.title: How Much Does the European Union Really Cost Us? One Coffee a Day
reels.hook: The whole European Union costs you one coffee a day
reels.why: It reduces the abstract topic of the EU budget to an image everyone understands. The numbers give weight, and it ends with a strong rhetorical question.
reels.speaker: Tonino Picula
reels.quote: Is that worth one coffee a day?

cards.text: The whole European Union costs you one coffee a day
Tonino Picula, Member of the European Parliament
The EU is agreeing on a seven-year budget: some want it generous, others would cut it.
Proposed EU seven-year budget
of the GDP of all 27 countries combined
citizens of the European Union
Is that worth one coffee a day?

reels.title: Why the Largest Oil Producer Is Asking Russia for Diesel
reels.hook: The largest oil producer begging Russia for diesel?
reels.why: A paradox that immediately intrigues, with a clear explanation of causes and a sharp point about how Americans evaluate the president.
reels.speaker: Tonino Picula
reels.quote: They have a political thermometer towards the White House, not because of foreign policy, but about what things cost in the supermarket.

cards.text: The largest oil producer begging Russia for diesel?
Tonino Picula, Member of the European Parliament
Trump is asking for diesel from Russia. Picula explains why.
The US is the world's largest oil producer.
The attack that complicated the energy market
Political thermometer towards the White House: what things cost in the supermarket.

reels.title: The Secret of Student Plenums That Even the Secret Service Failed to Penetrate
reels.hook: Even the secret service did not find out what the students were planning
reels.why: It answers the question from the episode title, who stands behind the students, and reveals the secretive way of working that brought down Vučić.
reels.speaker: Tonino Picula
reels.quote: No wonder not enough is known about them in Croatia, when not enough was known about them even in Serbia itself.

cards.text: Even the secret service did not find out what the students were planning
Tonino Picula, European Parliament Rapporteur for Serbia
The student list defeated Vučić in the elections in Serbia on October 25.
All major decisions were made at plenums at the faculties.
Not even the Serbian security agency managed to penetrate the plenums.
Not enough was known about them even in Serbia itself.
Tonino Picula – On Serbia After the Elections | Čušpajz #167

reels.title: 27 Flags Turned in the Same Direction Only by the Wind
reels.hook: Why does the European Union never decide quickly?
reels.why: It simply explains the key difference of the EU, with a humorous image of flags in Strasbourg, and ends with a clear stance.
reels.speaker: Tonino Picula
reels.quote: It is not a common state. It is a community of states.

cards.text: Why does the European Union never decide quickly?
Tonino Picula, Member of the European Parliament
It is not a common state. It is a community of states.

reels.title: Should Croatia Fear the New Serbia? Picula: No!
reels.hook: Will Brussels push Serbia ahead of Croatia?
reels.why: It addresses a fear shared by a part of the Croatian public. It carries a clear, confident message and a memorable saying about the boogeyman.
reels.speaker: Tonino Picula
reels.quote: As for Serbia itself, it is no boogeyman.

cards.text: Will Brussels push Serbia ahead of Croatia?
Tonino Picula, European Parliament Rapporteur for Serbia
Part of the public fears that the EU will speed up Serbia's path at the expense of Croatia.
As for Serbia itself, it is no boogeyman.
No one will declare Serbia the best student overnight

reels.title: Internet Went Down, So He Talked to the Housemates: "Fine People"
reels.hook: Is your mobile phone smarter than you?
reels.why: Short, witty, and universal: a sharp remark about mobile phones and a joke with a hilarious ending.
reels.speaker: Tonino Picula
reels.quote: Today, smartphones are often much smarter than those holding them in hand.

cards.text: Is your mobile phone smarter than you?

reels.title: Putin, the Russian Justinian: An Emperor Who Wanted to Restore an Empire
reels.hook: Putin finds a role model in a Byzantine emperor
reels.why: A historical comparison provides a fresh look at Putin's motives and ends with an ominous point about how it ended for Justinian.
reels.speaker: Tonino Picula
reels.quote: And I called him the Russian Justinian long ago.

cards.text: Putin finds a role model in a Byzantine emperor
Tonino Picula, Member of the European Parliament
Putin called the collapse of the USSR the greatest geopolitical catastrophe of the 20th century.
And I called him the Russian Justinian long ago.
